$Comment: Extra Thieves: catch Present Thieves (or the game's own grown Trorks) for Santa as often as a player
likes, for those who want to keep climbing his Nice List past the day's work. It opens once his first
quest (christmas_present_thieves) is done. An empty Repeat makes it repeatable with nothing holding it
back: no cooldown, no daily reset and no limit, so it is offered again the moment its pay is
collected. Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the report-back step to Santa after the hunt.
It is offered from Santa's quest list (What needs doing?) and never at his greeting: his
conversation's row for it names only its Active and Ready screens, so the start ladder never opens on
it as an offer. Listing.MainLine is false, so it reads as a side quest. The kills also pay favor on
their own through the Nice List's Kills table, so the quest's favor comes on top. Tune its Amount and
its favor together with the Kills Amount if thieves come faster than planned.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the hunt, waiting to be collected with the rest.
The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod,
unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Extra_Thieves
